notes: This focal candidate fills the Android runtime gap explicitly preserved by PR #336. It does not change the product implementation.

The selected test mounts the real common FeedScreenHost in Android instrumentation, starts on focused post A, opens the production Live panel, selects B and A through the stable post-ID controls, verifies both route callbacks and uses the common detail Back control to return to Feed.
The first dirty-tree run was a pilot and is not used as evidence. The recorded report comes from the repeated 1/1 pass on clean product SHA ce4cd4b1.
The fixture is deterministic and read-only. It does not mount the full Android AppNavGraph, contact the remote Feed repository, exercise media playback or broaden the earlier Web/iOS evidence.
OVR-LIVE-RANKING remains common with explicit limits rather than a global Live/Ranking GO; non-focal ranking routes and full app-shell behavior remain outside this attestation.

Any executable, workflow, runner, source, resource, test, configuration or dependency change after productSha invalidates affected evidence; attestation-only documentation remains subject to scripts/validate-candidate-attestation.mjs.
